latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the DuckDuckGo web search skill.

- Provides real-time web, news, image, video, and map searches using DuckDuckGo.
- Does not require an API key and protects user privacy.
- Supports region, safesearch, and timelimit customization.
- Includes example scripts in both English and Chinese for quick integration.
- Offers instant answers, search suggestions, and batch search capabilities.
- Installation instructions provided for both pip and uv.
